events.name: First Snag
events.intro: A Snag'em recruit is shaking a Makuhita out of a harness. "Not my kind of job," they mutter. "It still has a Shadow in it. Anything works on this one. Take it, it exists to teach you how to purify."

success.text: The recruit hands it over and walks away without looking back.

events.name: A Present With Strings
events.intro: A Snag'em contact holds out a Poké Ball. "A present. It has strings. Good luck with the strings." A passer-by whispers that it only ever softened for someone who stayed.

success.text: The ball is warm and heavy. Something inside is listening.
The contact shrugs and pockets the ball.
